title: Disc Station Bessatsu: I Miss You. Tanaka Katsumi
native_title: Ｄｉｓｃ Ｓｔａｔｉｏｎ別冊 ｉ ｍｉｓｓ ｙｏｕ． 田中 勝己
overview: Disc Station Bessatsu: i miss you. is a 1997 magazine special released by Compile in Japan. It comes with a disc either for Sega Saturn or Sony PlayStation. While it carries the "DiscStation" name, it is not a compilation of games, but rather of various music-related videos.
